base:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent game sprite sheet, 4 columns by 2 rows, eight equal square cells, 2048x1024.
Primary request: Original polished isometric 3D game artwork of a Clash of Clans level 1 Air Sweeper, consistent character of the same building in eight compass directions. Red vertically stacked accordion bellows pump, four squat splayed wooden support legs with small iron braces, curved square wooden turntable, chunky bent blue steel trumpet nozzle strapped with tan ropes. Bold toy-like forms, warm sun upper left, subtle material bevels. No damage, no blast.
Camera: orthographic isometric, looking down at 30 degrees, fixed camera and identical scale for every cell. Rotate entire building physically around its vertical axis in 45-degree steps. Each nozzle has the following screen-facing direction in reading order: cell 1 lower-right, cell 2 straight-down, cell 3 lower-left, cell 4 left, cell 5 upper-left, cell 6 straight-up away from viewer, cell 7 upper-right, cell 8 right. True side/rear views when required, do not just flip a front view. Keep the nozzle and rear red bellows consistent.
Composition: eight isolated sprites centered in eight cells of a strict 4x2 grid, generous transparent gutters. Each object including legs fits within 80% of cell width and height. Every cell has the same ground anchor and camera elevation. Authentic compact low-tier wooden defense silhouette, prominent red pump and powder-blue nozzle.
Constraints: actual transparent alpha background, no scenery, no ground tile, no floor, no labels, no text, no watermark, no borders, no baked shadow outside object. Not photographic, not pixel art.
variants: Enlarge the blue nozzle slightly, add a thick decorative blue ring around its mouth, replace tan rope straps holding nozzle with two smooth pale steel brackets. Keep all wood legs and red bellows.

Enlarge blue nozzle slightly, add a thick decorative blue ring around mouth, replace rope straps with smooth pale steel brackets. Reinforce every wooden leg with an additional broad pale steel brace; add pale metal strips on the platform sides. Wood remains plainly visible.

Enlarge blue nozzle slightly, add a thick decorative blue ring around mouth, replace rope straps with smooth pale steel brackets. Replace entire upper wooden platform with smooth pale steel, add gold straps and golden side reinforcements. Add solid steel footings and broad metal braces to all four wooden legs. Red bellows and blue nozzle remain.
mine:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: game animation asset sheet, three equal square cells in one horizontal row, transparent alpha background.
Primary request: Original polished isometric 3D game sprites for a Clash of Clans level 1 Seeking Air Mine in three states. Authentic chunky compact forms and vibrant toy-like mobile strategy game materials. Fixed orthographic isometric camera at 30-degree elevation, warm light upper left.
Cell 1 left: ARMED ground trap. Squat square wooden trap hatch / open wood rim, small dark charcoal metal spiked sphere nestled in its center, short silver conical spikes and tiny round glowing red sensor facing lower-right. Pale coiled tether rope in hatch. No inflated balloons on ground.
Cell 2 middle: FLYING mine with exactly three black round balloons bearing simple ivory skull symbols (two eye holes and a jaw). Golden tan cords attach the three balloons to a hanging dark metallic spiked sphere matching cell 1 with tiny bright red sensor. Entire flying object centered, all balloons fully visible with generous padding.
Cell 3 right: SPENT ground trap. Same squat square wood hatch as left, now empty with a curled tan rope and small deflated black balloon remnants. No sphere, no red light, no inflated balloons.
Constraints: every complete sprite in its own cell with transparent gutters; common ground camera. Actual transparent background, no ground plane, grass, floor, scenery, text, labels, grid lines, watermark, or exterior baked shadow. Preserve sharp readable silhouette at small scale.
